title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - DigitalRepresentation
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/DigitalRepresentation. A digital representation encapsulates a physical object accessible via Web services. Top-level class (general addition to SAREF, clause 5.1 of ETSI TS 103 410-2); not a subclass of any other SAREF4ENVI class.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'DigitalRepresentation'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasTag.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/hasTag'. A relationship stating the tags that can be assigned to an entity (e.g., a digital representation).

encapsulates.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/encapsulates'. A relation between a digital representation and the physical object(s) it represents. Functional (single-valued) in the ontology. Links to any SAREF/SAREF4ENVI FeatureOfInterest or FeatureKind entity (e.g. a Container, a Waste, a Light).

isAccessibleThrough.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/isAccessibleThrough'. The relation between a digital representation and the saref:Service (or saref:ServiceOfInterest) which it is accessible through. Functional (single-valued); saref:Service belongs to SAREF Core, out of this candidate's scope.
